decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC sit close to the core portfolio and support a growing market, so withdrawing them within a year is unlikely.
The marine box cooler is reported to hold a major market share in water cooling systems thanks to its quality, making it a strong product to keep.
The marine cooling unit has its own web page and complements the established marine cooling line, which signals a lasting commitment.
The compact oil cooler is only mentioned briefly, but it builds on existing know-how and has low carrying costs, so it is likely to stay.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology with a dedicated page and broad industrial demand.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes support the firm's efficiency promise and in-house R&D strengths, and they are prominently presented.
